# VR-WakerHD

> VR-WakerHD is an unofficial, open-source VR version of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD (Wii U, 2013), built on
> ZeldaWWHDRecomp, the native PC port (static recompilation) of the game. It adds an OpenXR VR mode: first person at
> Link's eyes with 6DoF head tracking, motion controllers with Link's arms following them, a physical sword, a
> shoulder item wheel and a wrist HUD. It runs on PC VR (Windows and Linux) and standalone on Meta Quest 3 and 3S. No
> game is included: players need their own copy of the Wii U game, and setup builds it on their own device.

Key facts:

- Name: VR-WakerHD. Also called: ZeldaWWHD-VR (earlier name), Wind Waker HD VR, Wind Waker VR port.
- Repository: https://github.com/VR-WakerHD/VR-WakerHD
- Website: https://vr-wakerhd.github.io/VR-WakerHD/
- Built on: ZeldaWWHDRecomp (https://github.com/ZeldaWWHDRecomp/ZeldaWWHDRecomp). That project is the flat-screen
  native port; VR-WakerHD is a separate VR-focused project built on it, not the same project.
- Not affiliated with Nintendo or with the ZeldaWWHDRecomp authors.
- Not an emulator and not a VR injector: the game's code is recompiled to native code, and the VR is built into the
  renderer and game logic.
- VR API: OpenXR with the Vulkan renderer (XR_KHR_vulkan_enable2).
- Platforms: Windows x86-64 (zip), Linux x86-64 (AppImage), Meta Quest 3 / 3S standalone (APK), Steam Frame / SteamOS
  arm64 (AppImage, not yet confirmed on the device). No VR on macOS.
- Runtimes tested: SteamVR (Windows, Linux), Monado (Linux), Meta Quest Link. Virtual Desktop and Air Link streaming
  are experimental.
- Headsets tested most: PlayStation VR2, Meta Quest 3 / 3S.
- Status: experimental, in active development; latest release 0.5.1 (November 2026).
- License: the VR mode is GPL-3.0-or-later with a credit term ("VR mode by VR-WakerHD"); the original port's code is
  MPL-2.0.
